meta.docTitle: Vertex Cloud Solutions × DataSkate — Integration Discovery
meta.docSubtitle: Scoping supplement for your MuleSoft engagement · HubSpot · NetSuite · Slack
meta.source: Discovery session with Vertex Cloud Solutions team (May 12, 2026)

bizContext.snapshot: Vertex Cloud Solutions closes $50K–$500K cloud infrastructure contracts through HubSpot. Every Closed-Won deal triggers a manual relay to finance: a rep notifies finance, finance logs into NetSuite, someone creates the subscription and invoice by hand. The 48-hour lag delays provisioning, defers ARR recognition, and leaves account managers blind to billing health until the next NetSuite report run.

journeyCards.label: Connected
journeyCards.headline: Closed-Won to Invoiced in Minutes, Not Days
journeyCards.body: HubSpot Closed-Won deals trigger NetSuite subscription and invoice creation automatically. Payment status syncs back to HubSpot so account managers see billing health without leaving their CRM. Slack ops-alerts fire on subscription created, invoice overdue, and renewal approaching — no dashboard monitoring required.

journeyCards.label: Automated
journeyCards.headline: Revenue Health Monitoring, Automatic Escalations
journeyCards.body: Overdue invoices trigger automatic escalation sequences: 30-day → account manager task + Slack ping, 60-day → revenue ops, 90-day → leadership flag. Renewal opportunities auto-create in HubSpot 90 days before contract end — renewal pipeline is always current without anyone running NetSuite reports.

journeyCards.label: Agentic
journeyCards.headline: Revenue Questions That Answer Themselves
journeyCards.body: An AI agent reads HubSpot pipeline, NetSuite subscription data, and billing history to surface accounts at risk before the CSM team opens their queue each Monday. The weekly finance reconciliation between HubSpot pipeline and NetSuite actuals runs automatically — your team reviews exceptions, not spreadsheets.

p0Blockers.title: HubSpot Private App Authorization
p0Blockers.body: — A HubSpot Private App token with read/write access to Deals, Contacts, Companies, and Custom Properties must be created by a HubSpot Super Admin before API configuration can begin. DataSkate will provide the required scope list. Owner: Vertex HubSpot admin.

p0Blockers.title: NetSuite REST API + OAuth 2.0 Setup
p0Blockers.body: — NetSuite REST Web Services must be enabled and an OAuth 2.0 integration record created by a NetSuite admin. DataSkate provides step-by-step setup instructions. Credentials stored in CloudHub Secrets Manager. This is a hard blocker — no architecture work can begin until confirmed. Owner: Vertex NetSuite admin.

sections.title: Use Cases
sections.bodyHtml:
UC-1

HubSpot Closed-Won Deal → NetSuite Subscription + Invoice (Event-Driven)

▼

Triggered when a HubSpot deal moves to Closed-Won. Creates a NetSuite customer (if not exists), subscription, and first invoice from the deal line items. NetSuite subscription ID written back to HubSpot deal as an external reference property.

What is the exact HubSpot deal stage value that triggers subscription creation in NetSuite? "Closed Won" was referenced in the discovery session — confirm the exact pipeline stage name. *
Closed Won Different stage name — specify below
If a NetSuite subscription already exists for this HubSpot deal (re-trigger scenario), what should happen? *
Skip — leave existing subscription unchanged Update the existing subscription Create a new subscription regardless
Which HubSpot deal properties should be written back after the NetSuite subscription is created?
From the session: NetSuite subscription ID, subscription status, and invoice ID were mentioned. Confirm or update the list.
In ScopeEvent-driven deal→subscription creation; NS subscription ID written back to HubSpot; deal line items mapped to NS subscription items
Assumed Pre-ExistsNetSuite Customer records can be matched to HubSpot Companies by email domain; custom HubSpot properties created before dev starts
Out of ScopeNetSuite credit checks or approval workflows; creating HubSpot line item objects from scratch
UC-2

NetSuite Invoice Status → HubSpot Deal (Scheduled Sync)

▼

Hourly or near-real-time pull of NetSuite invoice payment status into HubSpot deal records. Enables account managers to see billing health (paid, overdue, partial) in HubSpot without running NetSuite reports.

How frequently should invoice payment status sync from NetSuite to HubSpot? *
Hourly Every 15 minutes Daily (end of day)
Which HubSpot deal property should store the invoice payment status (e.g. Paid, Overdue, Partial)? *
If this property does not exist yet, DataSkate can provide the field spec for your HubSpot admin to create it.
invoice_payment_status (create new) Existing property — specify below
Should overdue invoices (30+ days) automatically create a HubSpot task or update the deal owner?
Yes — create a HubSpot task on 30-day overdue No — property update only, HubSpot workflows handle the rest
In ScopeScheduled NS→HubSpot invoice status sync; overdue flag update; optional HubSpot task creation on overdue
Assumed Pre-ExistsHubSpot deal matched to NS subscription via netsuite_subscription_id written in UC-1
Out of ScopeSending invoice PDFs to HubSpot; creating HubSpot workflows (client manages those)
UC-3

NetSuite Billing Events → Slack Notifications (Event-Driven)

▼

Billing events in NetSuite — subscription created, invoice overdue, renewal approaching — trigger formatted Slack messages to designated channels. Eliminates the need for anyone to monitor a NetSuite dashboard.

Which Slack channels should receive billing event notifications? *
From the session: #ops-alerts was mentioned for subscription created events. Confirm the channel name and whether overdue + renewal events go to the same channel or separate ones.
Which billing events should trigger Slack notifications? *
Subscription created Invoice overdue (30 days) Renewal approaching (90 days) All of the above
In ScopeSubscription created, invoice overdue, renewal approaching events → formatted Slack messages with NetSuite record link
Assumed Pre-ExistsSlack workspace app with incoming webhook or bot token available; target channels exist
Out of ScopeInteractive Slack commands (e.g. /lookup invoice); writing back to NetSuite from Slack actions

internalFlags.bodyHtml:
1
Auth model: HubSpot = Private App token (no OAuth callback required — simplest path). NetSuite = OAuth 2.0 token-based auth (TBA). All credentials in CloudHub Secrets Manager, rotated every 90 days.
2
P0 gate: Both P0 blockers must be confirmed resolved before architecture kickoff. If HubSpot app token or NS REST API setup is pending at discovery start, project timeline slips accordingly.
3
Deal→Subscription idempotency: Use HubSpot Deal ID as the external ID on the NetSuite Subscription record to prevent duplicate creation on re-trigger. Confirm that NetSuite supports externalId on Subscription records (it does — confirm with NS admin at field mapping session).
4
Buyer profile detected: roi-analytical (primary) + operational-pragmatist (secondary). Challenge framing uses the 48-hour lag number. Journey Stage 1 items lead with specific stopped behaviors. ROI section included in proposal.
